title: [Uber One] $20 off $100 Spend @ Coles via Uber Eats
body:
Deal: [Uber One] $20 off $100 Spend @ Coles via Uber Eats

[PissLUR] My email is $20 off $40+ spend. But on the app, it's $100+.
[foxes28] scroll right on the banner when you're on Coles app? you might have both offers
[Wiadro] I use my $20 off a $40 order a few days ago.
This one isn’t as good, but you can probably work the specials that are in the app and make it work
[King Tightarse] $20 0ff $40 is good 50% savings
$20 off $100 is only 20% savings which doesn't cover their huge markups so it does not motivate me to use them
[alikazi] There is a 40% off sale on cleaning items. Pretty good. Some other items have deals like 3 for $10, 2 for $4; easily beating in store prices. Combine altogether with $20 of $100 + 10% off gift card you hopefully got from SB and you have a great deal on your hands.
[donman92] 20% marked up prices but they are doing 40% cleaning products so ye 67 🤷‍♂️
[Agileduck] Last time I did one of these, a substitution was made which I had chosen and authorised, that did not reduce my spend below the minimum to get the discount.
After the delivery was made the save x amount was removed from the order so I didn’t get it. This was definitely the first time it happened (2 weeks ago?), I had substitutions before but didn’t lose the discount.
Anyone else have a similar experience?
[King Tightarse] No thats never happened to me before. I have had out of stock items refunded at full price when i got them discounted and that didn't alter the $ off before.
Of course they could change it at any time I suppose
[Agileduck] Yes it’s always been like this for me and it’s lead to some great savings. But maybe it’s changed now :(
[King Tightarse] If they took away your advertised savings with a substitution, that sounds like time for a talk to customer service.
[AlienC] had some issue similar where they did not track my promotions and offers and got charged full price basically that was not reflected on the uber eats app cart check out
had to talk with uber support and show screenshots of my cart and everything was an extremely laborious way to get some money back but it was a large order and the cart difference was worth it
but yeah sorry i usually do not like any substitutions so majority of my items are do not replace or ask for authorisation but high chance i just want what i picked so i would ignore a substitution if i can but honestly never been asked to substitute something from the buyer perspective
[lousy] Yes the Coles method is crap where they allow themselves to adjust the price right to the end. I had a similar experience. Now I have to screenshot the order in detail before it arrives to track the original order prices
[TEER3X] Don't schedule the order for a different day.
Prices change and you don't get the price that was shown when you submit your order.
[comk789] placed an order over $100 for the $20 discount. However, I received a completely different item from what I ordered. As soon as I reported the issue, I was refunded for the incorrect item, but the $20 discount was also removed, and I was charged the full amount
couldn't find any way to resolve this issue or contact anyone for help through the app. disappointing
[King Tightarse] That is way harsh.
It seems they have gone from very generous to total bastards with refunds
[comk789] Yeah, it's even worse. They refunded me for the item I originally ordered, but then charged me for the incorrect item they delivered instead
[Raj09] That is a snake move. I'm not going to try uber delivery.
[lousy] Yes it also annoys me when they charge the maximum service charge - then half the items are out of stock but the service charge stays the same
[DrPotato] I have had very good experience with their Facebook support team who seem to be more understanding. Defo worth trying with them
[BargainShopaholic] This was great, thanks OP! My local Coles had 40% off salmon showing, so grabbed some, some discounted meat. I made sure to turn off replacement for everything. Delivered all fine with long expiry.
[AlienC] Yeah coles on uber eats gives me a bit of anxiety as have had an experience where the offers and discounted prices shown on the uber eats catalogue and checkout aka cart did not reflect when the order finally arrived so now it feels like a risky gamble of maybe having to waste time on chasing up improperly recognized deals and offers
pro tip if you can remember: screenshot your cart and check out and if you really can your individual items or at the very least the list of items showing pricing and discounts sales offers etc clearly because you might need it when you get incorrectly charged
[lousy] Is there anyway to also set it so it’s do not replace for all items in the cart ? Takes so long to change them one by one to refund only
[ozbargainshopping] Just got absolutely wrecked by this Coles promo on Uber Eats and want to warn everyone before you buy. I spent $108 to qualify for the $20 off, but because Coles was out of stock on two items, my total dropped under $100 and the app instantly stripped the discount, making me pay way more money for less.
To make a bad joke worse, the 2kg family lasagne I was actually invoiced and charged for was missing from the bag, and when I reported it, the automated bot glitched out and gave me a $0 refund. Learn from my nightmare and pad your basket to at least $120 so out-of-stock items can't drop you under the limit, and if you do get burned, bypass the broken "Missing Items" button entirely and go to Help then Another order issue to demand a human review.
[King Tightarse] Hey thanks for the warning. I will be giving this promotion the big avoid until they fix these issues up.
You are the third one to say the same thing
